purpose: One planned replay/phase authority and original-D1 return hold for preset T0 alignment; no correction P0, schedule, financial, queue, pay or query authority

fields.name: request_sha256
fields.bounds: 32 bytes; complete five-argument native admission input + captured native identity

fields.name: reason
fields.bounds: trimmed 1..2000 characters; no selector or schedule

fields.name: agency_id
fields.derived_from: actual weekly_source_groups.agency_id; never auth tenant substitution

fields.name: source_cas
fields.bounds: exact actual WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_CAS_V1 four-key output; no caller source assertion

fields.name: initial_row_signature
fields.bounds: actual canonical current owner signature, 1..512 characters

fields.name: canonical_family_booking_id
fields.bounds: actual native canonical family identity; no new derivation ladder

fields.name: original_draft_invoice_no
fields.derived_from: actual original invoice invoice_no, preserving NULL

fields.name: current_timesheet_id
fields.bounds: same captured canonical family and Contract-week; fresh current native resolution

fields.name: current_row_signature
fields.bounds: actual canonical current owner signature, 1..512 characters

fields.name: return_hold
fields.bounds: true only after actual REMOVE committed; cleared only after proven exact original-D1 RETURN or lawful no-D1 case

fields.name: outbox_id
fields.derived_from: actual public.ts_financials_outbox.id; no FK because native completion deletes queue row

fields.name: current_financial_id
fields.derived_from: actual current native TSFIN writer/read postcondition

fields.name: native_receipts
fields.bounds: object <=65536 bytes; finite owner-named receipts with actual identities/hashes, no secrets or caller phase/readiness

fields.name: last_refusal_code
fields.bounds: finite native error/refusal code only, <=200 characters; no raw network/error payload

fields.name: completed_receipt
fields.bounds: closed complete receipt <=16384 bytes; only with actual completed postconditions

constraints: No mutable update to any immutable identity/input field; one audited native phase owner, immutable-update guard and exact fields verifier
Unique ACTIVE canonical family booking identity within actual agency; one ACTIVE Contract-week; unique request_key plus full digest refusal on conflicting actor/input
ACTIVE has completed_receipt/completed_at_utc NULL; COMPLETED has phase COMPLETED, genuine bounded complete receipt/time and return_hold false
return_hold implies ACTIVE and original_draft_invoice_id not NULL; hold never expires or is cleared by cleanup
original_draft_invoice_no preserves native NULL; do not fabricate or assign a number
outbox_id and outbox_reason paired; no caller job/run/task identity or synthetic lease
All references ON DELETE RESTRICT; durable reviewed history retained, no deletion endpoint or scheduler
Private policy and grants mapped only through existing audited logical-owner release machinery

replay.same_key: native current actor/identity/phase recheck then exact recorded completed receipt or next genuinely valid phase
replay.source_or_row_conflict: ACTIVE + last genuine phase + recoverable original-D1 hold; no silent rebase/force-complete
replay.crash_after_commit: native postconditions rederived, no double mutation

native_holds: actual authenticated TEST actor/session/top-RPC READ COMMITTED
